title: Characterizing the role of reasoning tokens in large language models as state over tokens - Nature Machine Intelligence
gist: Nature Machine Intelligence perspective argues LLM reasoning tokens should be understood as an externalized computational state that carries computation across generation cycles ('State over Tokens'), not as a faithful textual explanation, and that interpretability research should decode tokens as state rather than read them as text.

insights.claim: Reasoning tokens are not a faithful explanation of the model's actual reasoning process when read as text, creating a gap between how they appear and how they function.
insights.speaker: Nature Machine Intelligence
insights.so_what: Undermines reliance on chain-of-thought text as evidence of model reasoning, relevant to AI safety and monitoring claims.
insights.quote: when read as text, these tokens are not a faithful explanation of the model’s actual reasoning process

insights.claim: The State over Tokens framework reframes reasoning tokens as an externalized computational state, the mechanism that persists computation across separate generation cycles, rather than a linguistic narrative.
insights.speaker: Nature Machine Intelligence
insights.so_what: A reusable mental model for interpreting reasoning-model outputs.

insights.claim: SoT explains how tokens can drive correct reasoning without being a faithful explanation, and dispels two misconceptions: that the text records the complete process, and that the model uses words with the meanings a human reader ascribes to them.
insights.speaker: Nature Machine Intelligence
insights.so_what: Cautions against anthropomorphic readings of reasoning traces.

insights.claim: The authors argue research should move beyond reading tokens as text and also focus on decoding them as state, and that SoT surfaces previously overlooked research questions.
insights.speaker: Nature Machine Intelligence
insights.so_what: Points to interpretability work on intermediate tokens as an emerging area.
insights.quote: research should move beyond reading the tokens as text and also focus on decoding them as state

insights.claim: The reference list cites work on unfaithful chain-of-thought, steganographic chain-of-thought under process supervision, chain-of-thought monitoring and latent reasoning, indicating that faithfulness and monitorability are active debates.
insights.speaker: Nature Machine Intelligence
insights.so_what: Monitorability of reasoning traces is a live safety-research thread; the paper's own full arguments are paywalled.
